# Marcos Finkiel

Marcos Finkiel is a full-stack developer focused on real product development, logistics software, internal tools, dashboards and operational workflows.

Main stack:
- Angular
- Next.js
- React
- Node.js
- NestJS
- TypeScript
- PostgreSQL
- PHP

Main project:
AMXpress is a logistics operations platform case study featuring a customer portal, operations dashboard, backend APIs, mobile workflows, shipment tracking, labels, role-based access and Mercado Libre/Flex-related operational flows.

Secondary project:
Trackly is a secondary project showing product, frontend and backend implementation ability.
